desc:
🏠 THE FAMILY IS GONE. THE HOUSE IS YOURS 🏠

The family left for a few days... and the peaceful house quickly turned into a hunting ground.

💥 Fight anyone you see.
💰 Defeat players to earn Cash.
📋 Complete quests for extra rewards.
⚔️ Buy weapons and defend yourself.

But there’s one rule:

☠️ If you die, you lose your weapon.

Search the house, complete challenges, hunt other players and survive the chaos before the family comes back.

🏠 Huge House
⚔️ Multiple Weapons
💰 Cash & Quests
☠️ High-Risk Combat

🎮 PC • Mobile • Console
